headlines.title: ADB, 韓 성장전망 0.6%P 올려 3.2%

headlines.title: 서울 아파트거래 22%가 6억 이하 …정책대출 커트라인에 몰렸다
headlines.summary: 1만709건 거래…전년동기比 11% 급등 6억 초과하면 디딤돌대출 등 못 받아 매수세에 가격↑…“저가 아파트 소멸” 올해 서울에서 거래된 아파트 5채 중 1채 이상이 ‘6억원 이하’인 것으로 나타났다. 전셋값 급등에 대출 문턱마저 높아지자, 정책대출을 받을 수 있는 시세 6억원 이하의 집으로 매수세가 몰린 것으로 풀이된다.

headlines.title: 거래 말랐는데 신고가는 속출 …“ 2022년 급락장과는 다르다 ”
headlines.summary: 서울 아파트 거래량 석달새 62.8% 급감 역대 최고가 이어져…서울 외곽 급속 확산 가격하락 앞서 거래량 감소 과거 사례에도 “공급 부족·대출 제한에 시장 영향 제한적” 서울 아파트 매매 거래가 급감한 가운데, 신고가 거래는 곳곳에서 속출하고 있다. 하지만 시장에선 거래량 감소가 급격한 가격 조정으로 이어지긴 어려울 것으로 내다보고 있다.

headlines.title: 강남 넘어 오금동도 공사비 3.3㎡당 1000만원 육박
headlines.summary: ‘천정부지’ 치솟는 서울 재건축 공사비 송파구 오금현대 평당 962만원 제시 목동4·13단지 등 곳곳서 1000만원 공사비 급등에 분양가 1년새 34% 상승 반포·여의도·압구정 등 한강변 핵심 정비사업지를 넘어 서울 곳곳에서 3.3㎡(평)당 1000만원 안팎의 공사비 사례가 나타나고 있다.

headlines.title: 정부, 非중동 원유 수입부과금 환급 확대조치 재시행

headlines.title: 인구감소 · 주택거래 둔화 … 8월 이동자 수 53년 만에 최소
headlines.summary: ▲ 서울 아파트 인구 감소 흐름에 주택 거래까지 둔화하면서 8월 국내 이동자 수가 같은 달 기준으로 53년 만에 가장 적었습니다. 국가데이터처가 오늘(23일) 발표한 '8월 국내인구이동 통계'를 보면 지난달 국내 이동자 수는 47만1천명으로 1년 전보다 4.5%(2만2천명) 감소했습니다.

key_headlines.title: OECD Raises Korea's 2026 Growth Forecast from 2.6% to 3.7%
key_headlines.summary: International organizations including OECD and ADB have significantly raised South Korea's economic growth forecasts due to strong semiconductor exports and anticipated consumer recovery. This represents the largest upward revision among G20 nations.

key_headlines.title: Won-Dollar Exchange Rate Falls Below 1,350 as Oil Prices Decline
key_headlines.summary: The won-dollar exchange rate has decreased to the 1,350 level as oil prices decline amid easing US-Iran tensions and expectations of increased Saudi Arabian oil exports. Oil prices have become the key variable determining won exchange rates.

key_headlines.title: Seoul Apartment Transaction Volume Surges with 22% Trading Below 600 Million Won Threshold
key_headlines.summary: Over 22% of Seoul apartment transactions occurred below 600 million won, the policy loan cutoff line, with trading volume jumping 11% year-over-year. Buyers are concentrating on lower-priced apartments due to stricter lending requirements and high jeonse prices.

key_headlines.title: Korea to Build Eight Nuclear Power Plants in US Including Korean APR1400 Model
key_headlines.summary: Korea and the US are jointly pursuing the construction of eight nuclear power plants in America, including six Westinghouse AP1000 units and two Korean-developed APR1400 units. This marks a significant expansion of Korean nuclear technology into the US market.

key_headlines.title: Government Reduces Treasury Bond Issuance by 5 Trillion Won Using Surplus Tax Revenue
key_headlines.summary: The government announced plans to reduce October treasury bond issuance by 5 trillion won using surplus tax revenue to stabilize the domestic bond market amid rising interest rates. Economic policymakers held an expanded macro-financial meeting to monitor market conditions.

sections.Hot Economy News: International organizations have significantly raised South Korea's 2026 economic growth forecasts, with OECD increasing projections from 2.6% to 3.7% and ADB raising them to 3.2%, citing strong semiconductor exports and expected consumer recovery. The won-dollar exchange rate has declined below 1,350 won as oil prices fall due to easing geopolitical tensions and increased Saudi Arabian oil exports, making crude oil prices the key variable in currency movements. Korea and the US have announced plans to jointly build eight nuclear power plants, including Korean APR1400 models, expanding Korean nuclear technology's footprint in the American market. Seoul apartment transaction volumes show concentrated activity in properties below 600 million won, the policy loan threshold, with trading volume surging 11% year-over-year as buyers seek access to government lending programs.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: The government has reduced October treasury bond issuance by 5 trillion won using surplus tax revenue in response to rising interest rates and bond market instability. Economic authorities including the finance minister, central bank governor, and financial regulators held an expanded macro-financial meeting to monitor domestic bond market trends and coordinate policy responses. National debt as a percentage of GDP is projected to decrease to 48.3%, though analysts note this may be partially due to temporary nominal GDP expansion from semiconductor boom rather than structural improvement. Interest costs on national debt are expected to rise from 36.5 trillion won this year to 42.8 trillion won next year as interest rates climb.
sections.Financial Markets: US 10-year Treasury yields surged to 5.34%, marking a 24-year high, as global bond markets experienced synchronized selling pressure. US stock markets showed mixed performance with the Dow declining 0.9% while the Nasdaq rose 0.46%, as investors grappled with elevated Treasury yields despite softer inflation data. Core PCE price index came in lower than expected, reducing market expectations for additional Federal Reserve rate increases at the October FOMC meeting, with futures markets pricing in only 37% probability of a hike compared to 70% a week prior. Rising Treasury yields continue to weigh on equity valuations despite moderating inflation signals.
sections.Industry & Technology: Hyundai Motor has received government approval to streamline administrative procedures for converting its Ulsan plant to electric vehicle production from 40 months to 12 months, supporting the company's 4 trillion won investment in facility transformation. LG Energy Solution partnered with US electric commercial vehicle startup indiGOTech to supply cylindrical 46-series batteries for next-generation commercial EV models from 2027 to 2030. SemiPive and MobileInt collaborated on commercializing AI semiconductors for industrial robots under the K-on-device AI initiative. LG Electronics announced plans to establish a chiller manufacturing facility in Virginia with annual production capacity starting in the first half of 2027 to meet growing AI data center cooling demand in North America.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment values have reached a record 86-week consecutive price increase, surpassing the longest streak during the Moon administration, driven by dual-income millennial and Gen X buyers concentrating on non-Gangnam areas amid scarce jeonse supply. Gangnam apartment prices are declining sharply amid reconstruction selection announcements, with some prices falling billions of won, while Northern Seoul and mid-priced apartments remain resilient without typical price coupling effects. The concentration of buyers in the 600 million won price range reflects the policy loan threshold, with real estate agents warning of extinction of ultra-low-priced apartment stock. Cheongju's real estate market center is shifting southward as major urban development projects cluster in the region, establishing southern Cheongju as the new residential hub.
sections.International Economy: US Treasury yields reached 24-year highs as global bond markets sold off, signaling prolonged monetary tightening despite moderating inflation indicators and reduced Fed rate hike expectations. European premium automakers facing challenges in Chinese markets are pivoting toward North America, emphasizing large SUVs that offer better profit margins and align with consumer preferences, with companies exploring increased US-based production. Former US President Trump expressed opposition to further Federal Reserve interest rate increases and mentioned possible military escalation against Iran after midterm elections. Global equity markets remain volatile amid high Treasury yields, though Fed rate hike probability has declined based on softer-than-expected inflation data.
sections.AI & Economy: LG Electronics is establishing an air-cooled chiller production facility in Virginia to supply growing AI data center cooling demand, with production targeting the first half of 2027 to address North America's rapid datacenter expansion where 60% of global datacenter power capacity growth through 2030 is concentrated. LG CNS partnered with global investment firm General Atlantic to jointly identify and invest in enterprise software and AI technology companies, expanding Korean tech firms' presence in the global AI ecosystem. China's Tencent is leasing Oracle data centers worth $7 billion, the largest such deal, to overcome high-performance chip constraints imposed by US export controls on advanced AI semiconductors. South Korea's Ensinal gas-fired power plant project in Texas targets AI data center electricity demand with a tolling model where fuel costs are borne by purchasers, ensuring revenue stability for the 22.3 billion dollar investment.
sections.Others: South Korea's foreign ministry expressed expectations for progress in US-Korea relations following Trump administration's announcement of Korean investment in nuclear plants, LNG projects, and power generation facilities totaling billions of dollars. A proposal by Gyeonggi Province Governor Choo Mi-ae for local tax reform on three major issues has advanced to the National Assembly legislative process. The Lee Kun-hee collection exhibition in the UK demonstrated Samsung's soft diplomacy effectiveness and philosophy of sharing, attracting senior British government officials and global semiconductor industry leaders. Korea's customs authority eliminated the upper limit on whistleblower reward payments and introduced progressive incentive structures to maximize reporting effectiveness against smuggling and customs tax evasion.
